descriptions.text: Tiles from a transit authority that no longer exists. Water to the chest, black, with a rainbow that is not beautiful. Things bump your legs and do not apologize. West climbs back to the dock. East continues into the dark.

obstacles.fail: The east arch is a throat of black water. Chemical film burns your eyes. Without a breather you would be a story the canal tells.
obstacles.pass: The breather ticks against your teeth. You sink to the chest and walk the drowned hall.
